curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the title, who must register and when, what registration needs, yearly tabs, separate address records and plate display.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per title, registration and plate rule; contrast card for license versus vehicle address.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on registering a vehicle and keeping records current.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the seller's report of sale and plates, the buyer's title transfer, and dealer filings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Seller and buyer cards; contrast card for five versus fifteen days.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who files what after a sale.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the insurance requirement, proof of coverage and the three minimum amounts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Requirement and minimum cards; contrast card for the three amounts.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the coverage minimums.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach learning each vehicle, adjusting the seat, wheel and headrest, then maintenance of tires and glass.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Setup and maintenance cards; contrast cards for seat versus headrest and tread versus pressure.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on setup and maintenance checks.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what assist systems do, their limits, when to keep them on, and the main feature types.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Feature and limit cards; contrast card for the blind-spot alert's range.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what assist systems can and cannot do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the legal headlight hours, why daytime running lights are not headlights, and the high-beam dimming distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Headlight cards; contrast cards for running lights and the two dimming distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on when to use and dim headlights.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach brake-light warnings, signaling distance, hand signals and hazard lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Signal cards; contrast cards for the two hundred-foot rules and the hand signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on signaling your intentions.
